message.content: According to the data, Saffron discusses Cersei Lannister's character and highlights the reasons behind her choices and transformations in the series. Specifically, Saffron points out that Cersei was "blinded by power." This indicates that Saffron believes Cersei was driven primarily by a desire for power and was willing to do whatever it took to maintain or gain it, even if it meant sacrificing her relationships and causing harm to others. Saffron suggests that Cersei's relentless pursuit of power was so consuming that it overshadowed her other qualities and desires.
